definitions.explanation: A small, portable data-storage device, especially a USB flash drive. "Memory Stick" is also the name of a memory-card format developed by Sony.

examples.japanese: メモリースティックにデータを{保存|ほぞん}した。
examples.english: I saved the data to a memory stick.

examples.japanese: メモリースティックをパソコンに{差|さ}し{込|こ}む。
examples.english: I plug the memory stick into the computer.

examples.japanese: {発表|はっぴょう}の{資料|しりょう}はメモリースティックに{入|い}れて{持|も}って{行|い}った。
examples.english: I put the presentation materials on a memory stick and took them with me.

notes:
A loanword from English. In everyday Japanese it usually means a USB flash drive; it is also the name of a memory-card format developed by Sony.

USAGE:
- メモリースティックに{保存|ほぞん}する: to save to a memory stick
- メモリースティックを{差|さ}し{込|こ}む: to insert a memory stick

SIMILAR WORDS:
- USBメモリ: USB flash drive — the more common everyday term in Japan
- メモリーカード: memory card — a flat card used in cameras and other devices
